text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho—the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown. In other words, 
entering the tiger's den of premier 
racers.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To me, it is mere interlude, a passing 
milestone. Yet the audience demands my 
victory in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fret not, I have no intention whatsoever 
of holding back the proof! Let us shatter 
our predetermined fate and pour the 
celebratory toast of victory!
